sources.snippet: Argonne-Qwen1.5-.5B-think is a 0.46 billion parameter chain-of-thought reasoner developed by PursuitOfDataScience, fine-tuned from Qwen1.5-0.5B. It specializes in elementary math word problems, producing explicit reasoning traces and a final \boxed {} answer. This compact research model is designed for studying test-time compute on small models, demonstrating significant math-reasoning ...
